title: French and Francophone Studies, B.A. -- Language and Culture Option (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Language and Culture Option (of three: Language and Culture, Language and Literature, Language and Linguistics -- Language and Culture chosen since it's the only one with a fully detailed sample semester schedule; the other two describe requirements only in prose). Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. New fr_catalog.json (11 courses). Unlike Spanish's SPAN 1->2->3 (a formally coded prereq chain), French's FR 1/2/3 have no coded prerequisite at all -- verified via direct page inspection, not just a fetch gap; sequencing is implied only by course numbering and high-school-credit restrictions. FR 316/331/332/351/352/402Y all share the identical gate FR 201 AND FR 202 (not either/or). FR 430 gates one level further down, on FR 331 or FR 332 specifically. '4xx-level FR course' (3 occurrences) is modeled as a generic slot, matching the bulletin's own phrasing. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. RE-VERIFIED against the live bulletin (2026-08): found and fixed 2 real bugs. (1) 'FR 331/332/351/352' pool only had 2 occurrences (6cr) but the Common Requirements section requires 9cr (3 courses) and the live suggested plan itself shows 3 occurrences (1 in Fall Y3, 2 in Spring Y3) -- added a 3rd pick in Semester 6, converting one generic Elective into it. (2) Semester 5's 'FR 316' was hardcoded as a mandatory literal course, but the live Language and Culture Option requirements explicitly list it as 'Select one: FR 316, FR 417, FR 418, or FR 419' (3cr) -- converted to a 4-way options pool (fr_catalog.json already has all 4 codes with real prereqs, added for the sibling FRENCHBS build). CAMPUS CHECK (2026-09, Pattern A -- verified directly, not assumed): fetched this program's own live bulletin page and checked its 'At which campus can I study this program?' toggle (the current UI's version of the 'Where can I complete this program?' section; confirmed identical text on the archived 2022-23 through 2025-26 editions too, so this is a stable, long-standing program design, not a one-year snapshot). It reads 'Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus' / 'End Campus: University Park' -- i.e. this major can be started at any Penn State campus, Erie (Behrend) and Brandywine specifically included (no exclusion listed beyond the seven campuses scheduled for closure after Spring 2027, neither of which is Erie or Brandywine), as a 2+2-style feeder, but must be completed at University Park; the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan section confirms this isn't a separate curriculum by publishing a second, full 'Language & Culture Option ... at Commonwealth Campuses' SAP table alongside the University Park one, both drawing on the identical Common/Option Requirements course lists and credit totals, with only the LA 83/LA 283 Liberal Arts Seminar credits shifted to different semesters (University Park: 1.5cr in Semester 1 + 1.5cr in Semester 4; Commonwealth: both 1.5cr chunks land in Semester 5 instead, since a Commonwealth-campus student's 'first year' and 'second year' at Penn State overall don't line up with their first two semesters specifically at University Park) and an explicit Advising Note that 'Students pursuing this major at a Commonwealth Campus might require summer attendance, study abroad, or additional semesters to complete the major coursework' -- textbook Pattern A per docs/BRANCH_CAMPUS_FINDINGS.md (same course list/credit total, a 2+2 structure). 'campus' above is the full 19-non-World-Campus-entry PSU_CAMPUSES list (planner_engine.py's registry minus 'World Campus', which this major's own SAP tables never reference as a delivery category -- only 'University Park Campus' and 'Commonwealth Campuses' -- and which doesn't fit a physical 2+2 'Begin Campus' feeder model for a major this oral-communication-heavy), not narrowed further, since the bulletin's own text draws no distinction among individual Commonwealth campuses. DATA-QUALITY FLAG (found while building the sibling FRENCHBA-2025.json historical file, not fixed here since it's outside this batch's authorized edits to this file): this file's own Semester 4 carries only ONE 3cr GEN ED slot (13.5cr total) alongside FR 201/FR 202/the Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar slot/B.A. Requirement, but a raw <table class="sc_plangrid"> row-by-row parse of this exact page's live HTML (not WebFetch's AI summary) shows Second Year Spring as SIX items totaling 16.5cr -- FR 201, FR 202, LA 283, TWO separate 3cr GEN ED slots, and the B.A. Requirement -- which is also what the page's own per-semester subtotals add up to (17.5+16+14.5+16.5+15+15+13.5+15=123, matching the SAP's own printed 'Total Credits 123' footer) even though the separate Program Requirements table's 45+18+24+33 prose states 120 as the bare minimum. This file currently totals 120, one 3cr GEN ED slot short of the SAP's own printed 123 -- worth a follow-up pass to confirm whether that's a deliberate normalization to the stated minimum or a dropped slot.
